name: OpenRouter
description: OpenRouter chat-completion provider — single API key, hundreds of models. Claims the 'openrouter' model prefix (e.g. 'openrouter/anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5'). Wraps the canonical OAICompatClient from local-oai-provider with OpenRouter's defaults (openrouter.ai/api/v1, HTTP-Referer + X-Title headers). Reads the API key from plugins.openrouter-provider.apiKey or the legacy OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var.
